reason: A GitHub retrieval plugin that provides agent tools for searching repositories and issues or pull requests and reading repository, issue, pull-request, and file contents through the GitHub API.

summaries.zh: 通过 GitHub API 搜索仓库、Issue 和 Pull Request，并读取仓库元数据、正文及文件内容。
summaries.en: Search GitHub repositories, issues, and pull requests, and retrieve repository metadata, bodies, and file contents through the GitHub API.

capabilities: Searches GitHub repositories and issues or pull requests
Retrieves GitHub repository metadata, issue or pull-request bodies, and decoded files
Makes read-only requests to the GitHub API
Optionally reads a GitHub token from an environment variable
